excludedFiles.reason: PR #94 is editing this case study. The page stays out of the scan until that PR merges, so its error count can change without turning main red. The only edit in this PR is the style.min.css cache-bust query, which the minification check rewrites on every CSS change. Remove this exclusion after #94 merges and fix or baseline whatever is left.

rules.element-permitted-content: Two case-study service lists nest a ul directly under a ul. Wrapping that list in an li adds a bullet, so the authored structure stays until the page is rewritten.
rules.empty-heading: cookies/index.html has an empty h4 between two sections. The heading margin is part of the gap. Filling or removing it is an editorial choice.
rules.long-title: These published document titles are longer than 70 characters. Shortening them changes the title shown in search results.
rules.no-inline-style: Remaining style attributes are one-off presentation: package colors, case-study spacing, and homepage layout. Repeated patterns (calendar frame, phone-form width, footer logo, hero heights, diagram widths, the blog services heading) now live in CSS.
rules.prefer-native-element: Two comparison tables use div.table-wrap with role=region, the scrollable-region pattern this repo requires. A native section would inherit section { padding: 60px 0; overflow: hidden; } and change the layout.
